## About SYREN

SYREN is a fast-growing startup revolutionizing supply chain optimization with advanced analytics and data engineering solutions. Founded in 2020, SYREN is dedicated to delivering innovative tools that enable businesses to enhance efficiency, collaboration, and resilience across supply chains. Our solutions empower clients to unlock value through dynamic control towers, and seamless data-driven processes.

Headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a key office in Hyderabad, India, SYREN operates across the Americas and APAC regions. We work closely with clients worldwide, combining our expertise in technology and supply chain management to deliver tailored solutions that transform operations and drive superior business performance.
